name: smwmusic-touhou-tenporoku-combinations-with-you-bgm00
title: Touhou Tenporoku ~ Combinations With You - bgm00
description:
A Touhou-style remix of the FamilyMart jingle, which in turn spawned a short script featuring FamilyMart-themed danmaku.

It's got all the usual Touhou music hallmarks, but with the flair of a convenience store.

As far as I can tell, this song doesn't have a name, so I did my best to name it for the submission.

(FamilyMart is a Japanese chain of convenience stores.)
